sources.title: SupraLabs/SupraGDN-5M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are introducing SupraGDN-5M, a GatedDeltaNet-architecture-based model with 5 million parameters, pretrained from scratch as a base model on a single RTX Pro 4500 SE on 5B Fineweb-Edu tokens in about ~2.5 hours. This is the base work for future models, as the upcoming Supra3-family with our most capable tiny SOTA SLM models.
